speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To begin narrowing down the cause, have you noticed any changes in your urine color or the appearance of your stool recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) is unlikely given the male gender; the combination of fatigue, severe pruritus, and risk factors for blood-borne viruses in a patient with a history of autoimmune disease strongly suggests Hepatitis C or HIV-related hepatitis. I will order serologies to confirm. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_Serology_Panel, HIV_Antibody_Antigen, HBsAg.
